actual_scope: One supervised numerical process from a separate clean local clone: six frozen CO checkpoints, regenerated fit32/test32/test128 streams, hidden and original-logit replay, fit-only scaling, 12 saved probe stationarity checks, test score/BCE/accuracy replay, and registered decision/seed-summary checks. boundary: Accept only the registered INCONCLUSIVE / NO_USEFUL_LINEAR_READOUT branch for this fixed linear probe and these streams. Failure to recover a useful linear readout does not establish absence of b information, exclude nonlinear encoding, or support a Gate 1 mechanism claim. This audit reused the frozen repository reproduction module; it was not a separately implemented numerical analysis.
